description: Ihagee于1951年推出的数码单反相机。配备via an exposed lever on the left of the lens flange。快门速度vertically acting guillotine using the mirror as one component; due to this maximum speed is limited to 1/150, speeds: 1/25-1/150 +B。

specs.镜头: via an exposed lever on the left of the lens flange
